entities.summary:
Operation Southern Spear was a 2025–2026 US military operation against drug trafficking, launched on November 13, 2025, with the aim of disrupting global narcotics networks and securing the US-Mexico border. This operation marked a significant escalation in the US government's efforts to combat the opioid epidemic and transnational organized crime, with a particular focus on the Sinaloa Cartel and other Mexican trafficking organizations. The operation involved cooperation between US military, law enforcement, and intelligence agencies, as well as diplomatic engagement with Mexican authorities to share intelligence and coordinate counter-narcotics efforts. The impact of Operation Southern Spear rippled forward in time, influencing the trajectory of US-Mexico relations and the global response to the opioid crisis.

The core events of Operation Southern Spear involved a range of activities, including military operations, intelligence gathering, and diplomatic engagement. On the ground, US and Mexican forces conducted joint operations to disrupt trafficking routes and seize assets, while also providing support to local communities affected by the opioid crisis. The operation also saw the establishment of a dedicated counter-narcotics task force, which brought together experts from across the US government and Mexican agencies to share intelligence and coordinate efforts. Through Operation Southern Spear, the US government demonstrated its commitment to combating the opioid epidemic and disrupting transnational organized crime, with significant consequences for the global narcotics trade and the US-Mexico border.
